## Summary

I implemented the rule that rejects creating an owner whose lower-cased email already belongs to another owner, responding with **409 Conflict**. Following the existing patterns in this Spring Boot app (mirroring the duplicate-telephone rule):

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — after the email is normalized (lower-cased) and after the telephone-duplicate check, it now rejects the create when the email is already in use. The check is skipped when no email is supplied (the field is optional), so two owners with no email don't collide. Added a private `isEmailInUse` helper that compares case-insensitively against existing owners.

The new acceptance test `Cp25Tests.coreRejectsDuplicateEmail` passes, and the full suite (35 tests) remains green.
